This role is a foundational member of Regeneron's first GCC and will drive the expansion and scaling of commercial capabilities across Insights \& Analytics, Commercial Operations, and Market Access. * Oversee leaders responsible for Insights \& Analytics, Commercial Operations, and Market Access functions.

**Position Summary**
**Associate, Budget \& Operations Associate**
 The Budget \& Operations Associate will support the US\-based Manager and India\-based Specialist in delivering accurate, timely, and efficient budget and operational activities for the marketing organization. The role will focus primarily on recurring budget tracking, reporting, data validation, reconciliations, invoice support, and follow\-up activities.
   

  

 The Associate will develop a working understanding of the marketing organization’s needs and priorities and will execute assigned activities using established processes, templates, and tools.
   

  

 We are looking for a detail\-oriented and organized candidate with a foundation in business operations, budget management, financial reporting, and data analysis. The successful candidate should be comfortable working with data, preparing clear reports, managing recurring tasks, and learning new tools and processes.
   

  

**Work you’ll do**
* Develop an understanding of the marketing organization’s business needs and priorities and gather information required for assigned activities
* Support budget management activities, including tracking, updating, monitoring spend, performing basic variance checks, and following up on outstanding items
* Obtain, organize, and maintain expense information and supporting documentation for review by your leader
* Prepare accurate recurring reports related to budget, capacity, utilization, and forecasts using established templates and reporting processes
* Perform routine data validation, reconciliations, and quality checks across budget, hours, expense, and operational data
* Identify discrepancies, resolve straightforward data issues, and escalate complex or unusual items for further review
* Support fiscal year operating plan activities by gathering inputs, updating tracking files, documenting changes, and monitoring follow\-up actions
* Assist with the development, maintenance, and quality assurance of reports and dashboards
* Support staffing capacity and utilization reporting and basic forecasting activities
* Prepare basic analyses and summaries that highlight trends, variances, and items requiring management attention
* Maintain dashboards and tracking tools used for recurring reporting and operational monitoring
* Complete assigned follow\-up activities with Finance and other designated contacts
* Identify opportunities to improve recurring processes and implement agreed\-upon enhancements
* Maintain organized documentation and ensure assigned deliverables are completed accurately and on time


 Partner with Finance to:
   

  

* Coordinate routine Finance requests and follow\-ups based on directions from the Manager or Specialist
* Develop a working understanding of Deloitte’s financial environment and its impact on operations
* Support year\-end close and accrual activities by gathering information, preparing schedules, and tracking completion
* Prepare supporting information for costs requiring journal entries and coordinate submission activities with Finance under established procedures
* Support cost allocation and cost management activities using defined processes and guidelines
* Escalate questions, exceptions, and items requiring judgment to the Manager or Specialist


**Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of experience supporting budget management, financial operations, reporting, data analysis, or project coordination
* Experience working with budgets, expenses, invoices, or financial data; marketing organization or advertising agency experience is a plus
* Willingness to learn and use AI\-enabled tools to support budget management, improve reporting efficiency, and streamline financial tracking
* Working knowledge of data analysis, reporting, and data quality practices
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office tools; familiarity with PowerPoint, Power BI, and Tableau is preferred
* Experience managing or submitting invoices for processing, or the ability to quickly learn the firm’s invoice submission tools
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize routine information and flag questions or exceptions
* Exposure to capacity and utilization reporting or a willingness to learn these processes
* Ability to work effectively with the US\-based Manager, India\-based Specialist, Finance, and other designated stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, organization, time management, and follow\-through
* Ability to manage recurring activities, follow established processes, and prioritize assigned work
* Ability to support internal projects and contribute to project deliverables; prior project leadership experience is not required
* Ability to investigate and resolve routine issues and appropriately escalate more complex problems
* Collaborative, dependable, and comfortable working across time zones

**Description**
 Amazon seeks a results\-oriented, analytical Process Improvement Specialist to join the EU FBA Support Operations team. This role sits within our Seller Experience \& Insights pillar, focused on reducing escalation volume through rigorous root cause analysis, process improvement design, and cross\-functional coordination. You will own the analytical backbone of our escalation reduction program — investigating why escalations occur, designing the fixes, and measuring their impact.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, high\-depth role. You will deep\-dive into escalation data, map operational processes, identify systemic failure points, write structured root cause analyses, and drive process improvements through to implementation and measured impact. You will work closely with operations teams, product managers, and policy owners to ensure fixes are implemented — not just recommended.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Own root cause analysis (RCA) for escalation themes: investigate patterns across ticket data, map failure points in operational processes, and produce structured RCA write\-ups with clear findings, root causes, and recommended fixes.
   

  

 Build and maintain the escalation reduction roadmap: prioritize systemic issues by seller impact and volume, track progress against reduction targets, and report status weekly.
   

  

 Coordinate with cross\-functional teams (product, policy, operations, WW Support Ops) to drive implementation of fixes — ensuring issues have owners, deadlines, and closure criteria
   

  

 Design SLA frameworks and operational standards for escalation resolution, working with the operations team to define quality and timeliness benchmarks.
   

  

 Partner with the Voice of Seller specialist to connect escalation RCA findings with broader seller experience trends — turning reactive investigations into proactive prevention
   

  

 Produce dashboards and reporting that make escalation health, reduction progress, and process performance visible to the team and leadership
   

  

 Conduct regular Gemba walks and frontline observation sessions with escalation investigators to gather process insights directly — ensuring RCA findings are grounded in operational reality, not just data patterns
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 You start by reviewing escalation data for patterns and emerging failure modes. You identify a cluster, map the root cause, then validate it through a Gemba session with the operations team. You draft a structured RCA with a recommended fix and align with the product team who owns the system. You work on coaching of analytical methodology and update the escalation reduction dashboard. By Friday, the fix you proposed weeks ago shows up in the metrics — fewer escalations, better seller outcomes.

 Today, more than 60% of worldwide purchases from Amazon are made from third\-party selling partners, mostly from small\- and medium\-sized businesses.  The SOC Team Lead is a tactical leader who bridges technical expertise and leadership within the SOC. This role involves coordinating analysts’ activities, acting as the primary escalation point for complex incidents, and maintaining quality control over how incidents are handled and documented. The Team Lead still engages in hands\-on incident response when necessary, but also focuses on mentoring analysts and improving operational processes. In a financial industry SOC, the Team Lead pays special attention to adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies in all SOC activities, since consistent process is critical for both security and compliance.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Operational Oversight: Manage and oversee real\-time SOC operations during assigned shifts. This includes monitoring the flow of alerts and ongoing incidents, ensuring that all incoming security events are promptly assigned and addressed by the team. Balance workloads among analysts and maintain overall situational awareness of the organization’s security posture at all times.
* Incident Command \& Escalation: Serve as the primary escalation point for incidents that go beyond Tier1 or an individual analyst’s expertise. For high\-severity or widespread incidents, act as the Incident Commander, coordinating response efforts, making real\-time decisions on containment strategies (such as system isolation or shutdowns), and communicating status updates to management. Step in to directly handle or support particularly critical incidents alongside the team.
* Quality Assurance: Ensure quality control of the team’s incident handling and documentation. Review analysts’ incident reports and evidence to verify accuracy, thoroughness, and compliance with SOC procedures. Ensure that all required steps (analysis, containment, notification, etc.) are taken for each incident and that escalations include all necessary information.
* Shift Handoffs: Conduct and document shift handover meetings at the start and end of shifts. Clearly communicate any ongoing incidents, recent critical events, and operational issues to incoming Team Leads and analysts. Make sure there is a seamless transition so that active investigations continue without delay or information loss.
* Performance \& Metrics: Track SOC performance metrics (e.g., Mean Time to Acknowledge/Investigate/Close incidents, number of alerts handled, false positive rates). Use these metrics to identify bottlenecks or areas for improvement. Provide regular updates to the SOC Manager on the team’s performance and any resource or process issues.
* Training \& Development: Mentor and train SOC analysts to improve their skills. Conduct on\-the\-job training sessions, debrief significant incidents to extract lessons learned, and ensure analysts are familiar with new threats, technologies, and changes in procedures. Assist with onboarding new team members and promote knowledge sharing within the team.
* Process Improvement: Update and optimize SOC processes and documentation. Proactively identify inefficiencies or gaps in playbooks and standard operating procedures, and recommend enhancements. Work with the SOC Manager to implement new tools or updated workflows (such as new SOAR playbooks or reporting templates) to increase team efficiency and consistency.
* Tool and Environment Management: Ensure all SOC tools and systems are functional and being effectively utilized by the team. Coordinate with IT or engineering teams to fix any outages or performance issues in monitoring tools (SIEM, EDR, etc.). Verify that data feeds (logs, alerts) are flowing properly and that analysts have the technical resources needed to do their jobs.
* Compliance \& Readiness: Support the SOC Manager in enforcing organizational security policies and regulatory compliance in daily operations. This includes confirming that the team’s incident handling and documentation meet standards required for audits or industry regulations, which is especially critical in financial services. Drive readiness by organizing routine drills or simulations (e.g., incident response tabletop exercises) to ensure the team is prepared for various cyber scenarios.


 What you have
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Experience: 5\+ years of experience in cybersecurity operations or incident response, with at least 2–3 years in a senior SOC analyst or similar role. The candidate should have a demonstrated ability to handle high\-severity incidents and lead others. Prior experience in a team lead, technical lead, or supervisory capacity is strongly preferred.
* Technical Proficiency: Advanced hands\-on experience with SOC tools and processes. This includes expertise in using SIEM and EDR tools for analysis and an understanding of SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response) platforms for workflow automation. In\-depth familiarity with incident response procedures (containment, eradication, recovery) as formalized in frameworks like NIST or SANS. Able to step in and perform any analyst task (from triage to deep forensic analysis) if needed.
* Leadership Skills: Proven track record of coordinating team activities or leading small teams during critical operations. This could be evidenced by experience as a senior analyst who has taken charge during incidents or mentored junior staff. Strong organizational skills to manage 24/7 shift scheduling and ensure coverage.
* Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. title: Technical Business Analyst, Officer
description:
Role Summary
   

  

 The Business Analyst (BA) for the Alpha Index HUB (AIH) is a key contributor within the Product Organization, responsible for translating business, operational, and client needs into clear, actionable product requirements. The role supports the design, build, testing, and rollout of scalable index and benchmark data capabilities that are critical to Alpha’s data platform.
   

  

 This position works closely with Product Owners, Engineering, Quality Assurance (QA), Operations, and third‑party data vendors to ensure product enhancements are well‑defined, operable, auditable, and aligned with Alpha product strategy and delivery standards.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Product \& Requirements Management
   

  

* Partner with Product Owners to define, document, and refine product requirements aligned with Alpha Index HUB strategy and roadmap.
* Lead requirements elicitation through stakeholder interviews, workflow analysis, and data analysis.
* Produce high‑quality artifacts including Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), functional and non‑functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure requirements are clear, testable, and traceable through development and testing phases.


 Stakeholder Engagement \& Collaboration
   

  

* Act as the primary liaison between Product, Engineering, QA, Operations, and external vendors.
* Facilitate discussions to ensure shared understanding of scope, dependencies, risks, and expected outcomes.
* Work closely with Operations teams to incorporate operational workflows, controls, and exception handling into product requirements.


 Delivery \& Execution Support
   

  

* Support Agile delivery activities including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and sprint reviews.
* Define detailed acceptance criteria, covering positive, negative, and edge‑case scenarios, to enable effective QA and UAT/CUAT execution.
* Participate in testing activities and support validation of delivered functionality against business intent.


 Operational Readiness \& Risk Management
   

  

* Ensure product requirements address data quality, auditability, operational transparency, and control considerations.
* Contribute to the definition of dashboards, status indicators, and monitoring frameworks that support daily operational validation and issue detection.
* Assist with documentation and communication of field definitions, status meanings, and operational behaviors to reduce ambiguity and risk.


 Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, enhance usability, and improve operational efficiency.
* Support ongoing evolution and maturity of Alpha Index HUB capabilities in alignment with broader Alpha product and platform initiatives.


**Experience**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* 12\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, with level determined by role (BA, BA II, Senior BA).
* Experience working in a product‑led or Agile/Scrum delivery environment.
* Proven experience producing BRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.


 Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Ability to translate complex technical and data concepts into clear business requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
* Effective stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Hands‑on experience writing and reviewing SQL queries to support data analysis, validation, and issue investigation.
* Working knowledge of running, monitoring, and validating processes in the Charles River Development (CRD) environment, including awareness of upstream/downstream dependencies, batch processing, and operational workflows.


**Preferred Domain Knowledge**
* Experience with financial services, index, benchmark, or market data platforms.
* Familiarity with large‑scale data pipelines, dashboards, or operational monitoring tools.
* Understanding of data governance, controls, and audit considerations.


 Reporting \& Alignment
   

  

* Reports into the Alpha Product Organization.
* Works in close partnership with Alpha Index HUB Product Owners, Engineering leads, QA teams, and Operations stakeholders.
* Embedded within product delivery cadence, including sprint planning, refinement, and release activities.


 Measures of Success
   

  

* Requirements are clearly defined, consistently understood, and require minimal rework.
* Engineering and QA teams can deliver features efficiently with reduced clarification cycles.
* Operations teams gain improved visibility, consistency, and confidence in Alpha Index HUB processing.
* Product enhancements materially improve platform reliability, transparency, and scalability.
